name: Middle Finger Buttress - Left Side
approach: Approach exactly as for Cathedral Peak/Amphitheater: backpack to Upper Cathedral Lake (see West Route / peak-level approach), then walk the north shore and scramble roughly 15 minutes to the base of the buttress directly above the lake.

waypoints.name: Andrews Creek Trailhead
waypoints.directions: From Highway 20 in Winthrop, turn onto County Road 1213 (West Chewuch Road) and follow it about 6 miles to where it joins Forest Road 51. Continue north on FR 51 to the end of the pavement and turn right into the Andrews Creek Trailhead at 3,050 ft. A Northwest Forest Pass or Interagency pass is needed to park, and a free self-issued Pasayten Wilderness permit is required.

waypoints.name: Middle Finger Buttress area (Amphitheatre Mtn routes)
waypoints.directions: Hike Andrews Creek Trail #504 about 12 miles to Andrews Pass, keeping left near 5.5 miles and turning right at the Peepsight Trail junction. Descend 3 miles to the Spanish Camp guard station; just before the cabin take the trail on the right 3 miles up to Upper Cathedral Lake. Middle Finger, the biggest buttress on the wall above the lake, is a 15-minute walk and scramble from the shore.

waypoints.name: Middle Finger Buttress area, above Upper Cathedral Lake
